```{r}
library(readr)
library(ggiraph)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
library(vistime)
library(tibble)
library(patchwork)
```

```{r}
eclipse_data <- read_csv("data/formatted_eclipses.csv")
```

During the 21st century there will be 224 solar eclipses:

- 77 partial 
- 72 annular
- 68 total
- 7 hybrids

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="50%"}

```{r}
eclipse_data <- eclipse_data %>%
  mutate(
    hover = paste(
      "Type:",
      Type,
      "<br>Date:",
      Date,
      "<br>Time:",
      `Time_of_greatest_eclipse_terrestrial_time`
    )
  )

eclipse_colors <- c(
  "Total" = "#3d3a4b",
  "Hybrid" = "#d3c0cd",
  "Annular" = "#937666",
  "Partial" = "#e3dfff"
)


plot_ly(
  eclipse_data,
  type = "scattermapbox",
  mode = "markers",
  lat = ~Latitude,
  lon = ~Longitude,
  color = ~Type,
  colors = eclipse_colors,
  text = ~hover,
  hoverinfo = "text",
  marker = list(size = 7, opacity = 0.65)
) |>
  layout(
    mapbox = list(
      style = "open-street-map",
      center = list(
        lon = 0,
        lat = 0
      ),
      zoom = 1.5
    )
  )
```

:::

::: {.column width="50%"}

```{r}
#| label: timeline
#| fig-height: 2

eclipse_tab <- eclipse_data |>
  rowid_to_column() |>
  mutate(
    event = paste0("event", rowid),
    color = case_when(
      Type == "Total" ~ "#3d3a4b",
      Type == "Annular" ~ "#937666",
      Type == "Partial" ~ "#e3dfff",
      Type == "Hybrid" ~ "d3c0cd"
    )
  )

timeline_data <- data.frame(
  event = eclipse_tab$event,
  start = eclipse_tab$Date,
  type = eclipse_tab$Type,
  color = eclipse_tab$color
)

timelineplot <- vistime::vistime(
  timeline_data,
  col.event = "event",
  col.group = "type",
  optimize_y = T,
  show_labels = FALSE,
  linewidth = 5
)

pp <- plotly::plotly_build(timelineplot)
pp$x$layout$xaxis$tickfont <- list(size = 12)
pp$x$layout$yaxis$tickfont <- list(size = 12)

pp
```

```{r}
#| label: average duration time
#| fig-height: 4
#| fig-width: 7

eclipse_tab <- eclipse_tab |>
  mutate(eclipse_duration = str_replace(Central_duration_min_s, ":", ".")) |>
  mutate(eclipse_duration = as.numeric(eclipse_duration))

eclipse_colors <- c(
  "Total" = "#3d3a4b",
  "Hybrid" = "#d3c0cd",
  "Annular" = "#937666",
  "Partial" = "#e3dfff"
)

p <- eclipse_tab |>
  filter(eclipse_duration != is.na(eclipse_duration)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = eclipse_duration, fill = Type)) +
  geom_histogram(
    binwidth = 1,
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.7,
    position = "identity",
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    aes(xintercept = mean(eclipse_duration, na.rm = TRUE)),
    color = "#e07a5f",
    linewidth = 0.8,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Duration (minutes)",
    y = "",
    title = "Eclipse Duration",
    fill = "Type"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = eclipse_colors) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), panel.grid.major = element_blank())

p2 <- eclipse_tab |>
  ggplot(aes(x = "", fill = Type)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  labs(x = "", 
       y = "Proportion",
      title = "",
      fill = "Type") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = eclipse_colors) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), panel.grid.major = element_blank())


p + p2 + plot_layout(ncol = 2,
                    widths = c(0.9, 0.1))
```
